mechanism: Clipping by fixed height plus overflow:hidden. The container #shipping-info (.notice) has `height:40px; overflow:hidden` (content-box, padding 10px => 60px box). At 1440x900 the sentence (14px/20px) wraps to 2 lines (40px) and fits. At 390x844 the narrow column (~280px content width) wraps it to 4 lines (80px), so lines 3-4 are clipped; line 3 is cut mid-glyph at the bottom edge. Control case2-b uses `min-height:40px` instead, so the box grows to 100px.
